yoruba: Mo rí ọkọ̀ tuntun ní òpópónà.
english_meaning: I saw a new vehicle on the road.

yoruba: Bàbá mi lọ sí oko ní òwúrọ̀.
english_meaning: My father went to the farm in the morning.
I used money to buy food.

yoruba: Fọ ọwọ́ rẹ kí o tó jẹun.
english_meaning: Wash your hands before you eat.

yoruba: Ìgbà wo ni o máa dé?

english_meaning: Mother put water in the calabash.
The fish is in the water.
Ade bought leaves at the market.
My friend wants to buy fish.
My older sibling is reading a book.

yoruba: Mo gbọ́ ohun tí o sọ.
Ṣé o lè ràn mí lọ́wọ́?
Inú mi dùn láti rí ẹ!
english_meaning: I am happy to see you!
